audit.why: Poppy dominates lane against a no-CC enchanter and flips only late once Yuumi's heals/speeds/R root out-sustain the all-in on a fed carry — content win[] already states this (Poppy x6, Yuumi on 2+ items).
Spikes at level 2 (wall-pin threat vs zero peel), level 6 (Keeper's Verdict finishes a pick she can't stop), and first item (unpunishable engage window) are already in content spikes[].

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3-6].side were still the unfilled 'Skill' placeholder even though content win[] already resolved them (Poppy on 4-5/6/1st item, Yuumi on 2+ items). The R-vs-W channel-cancel interaction (both her Final Chapter and your Keeper's Verdict can be cancelled by the other's CC) was never stated, and two dosFull/dontsFull bullets were pasted-in tradeGood/tradeBad text unrelated to their own titles.
audit.why: Yuumi's Final Chapter (R) is a channel that Heroic Charge (E) cancels outright; her You and Me! (W) — 0s base CD, always up — likewise cancels a channelling Keeper's Verdict. That is matchup-defining for R sequencing and was absent from breakdown.cooldowns.
audit.corrected: phases[3-5].side -> 'Poppy', phases[6].side -> 'Yuumi' (all matching win[] already); why rewritten for rows 3-6; cooldowns now states the mutual channel-cancel; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d rewritten to match their own titles instead of the pasted trade lines.

edits.before: Keeper's Verdict online — the dive that survives everything still flies home.
edits.after: Keeper's Verdict finishes picks Yuumi has no peel to prevent — all-in the host.

edits.after: First item: your E-Q is nearly unpunishable — no CC from Yuumi.

edits.before: - Yuumi You and Me! (Attach): matchup-defining — Untargetable while attached — kill the host or catch the dismount windows. It writes your spacing rules. - W Steadfast Presence is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Yuumi You and Me! (W): untargetable while attached — commit only once she's dismounted or you've cornered the host. - Her Final Chapter (R) is a channel your E cancels outright, and her W cancels yours the same way — spend R only once hers is down.

edits.after: Yuumi has no hard CC to punish the pin — her Q slow lands free once the host over-steps her W attach.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.

notes: The remaining two missing interactions ('needs-antiheal' and 'onhit-itemization') aren't newly flagged as gaps: report[8] (Itemization) already covers anti-heal timing against Yuumi's sustain, and on-hit scaling didn't have a safe slot to add without exceeding the length band or duplicating existing content — noted for a follow-up pass. phases[0-2] and their why text were already correctly set to 'Poppy' from a prior pass and left untouched (still generic engage-template wording, but not a chart-agreement defect since no side is changing there).
